rule_executed.anchor_match: >=1 bp hg19 overlap between 5-kb interaction anchor and active promoter annotation interval

licensed_populations_before_C3.P1S_rule: Exactly one active-promoter anchor; gene identity not required for distal accessibility substrate-fit.
licensed_populations_before_C3.P3_rule: Exactly one active-promoter anchor AND one unique non-empty Nott-supplied Ensembl identity.

interpretation.finding: The significant Nott PLAC-seq table is H3K4me3-enriched but not every row is a uniquely oriented active-promoter-to-distal interaction. The source-only exactly-one-active-promoter rule retains 61.27% of the original interaction rows before coordinate harmonization.
interpretation.why_no_promoter_rows_are_not_parser_fail: Published downstream classification of Nott PLAC-seq includes promoter-to-enhancer/promoter/ATAC as well as H3K4me3-to-H3K4me3, H3K4me3-to-other, and other interactions. Therefore rows lacking an active-promoter overlap are structurally plausible and must be counted rather than rescued.
interpretation.claim_scope: This is a source-structure/eligibility audit only. It is not evidence that retained contacts are microglia-specific or biologically validated.

spillover_controls: No assumption that anchor1 or anchor2 is always promoter.
No gene identity from the simplified coordinate-only Microglia promoters sheet.
No AD loci, JEPA targets, NIH-CARD, Morabito, or project RNA.
No post-liftover coordinate used to decide source promoter identity.
